prds.title: Note Inspector requirements
prds.problem: Inspect a note’s declared metadata and review a possible edit.
prds.audience: Obsidian users who need use for contextual helpers, property editors or note-quality tools.
prds.goals: Use for contextual helpers, property editors or note-quality tools.
prds.nonGoals:
Bind active-note changes and lifecycle cleanup
Implement safe frontmatter updates and stale-note checks
Respect user pane placement; native right-sidebar placement is not generated
prds.notes: All requirements are designed, not implemented or verified.

requirements.title: Note properties
requirements.acceptance: Given the note properties surface, when the primary user action succeeds, then show the updated result; on failure preserve the draft and show a recoverable error. Implement the domain-specific assertions before marking this requirement complete.

requirements.title: Review metadata
requirements.acceptance: Given the review metadata surface, when the primary user action succeeds, then show the updated result; on failure preserve the draft and show a recoverable error. Implement the domain-specific assertions before marking this requirement complete.

requirements.title: Native lifecycle and data safety
requirements.acceptance: Given the plugin is enabled then disabled, all subscriptions, timers and UI resources are released; no unrelated notes or settings are changed.

requirements.title: Isolated acceptance
requirements.acceptance: Given an isolated development vault and synthetic data, verify the intended outcome with a failing test before implementing it. Scaffold tests and synthetic examples do not satisfy this acceptance.

# Starter scope

Metadata inspection and review surfaces
Note-record schema and a read contract
Visible edit draft with local reset behavior

## Implementation work

Bind active-note changes and lifecycle cleanup
Implement safe frontmatter updates and stale-note checks
Respect user pane placement; native right-sidebar placement is not generated

No business acceptance has passed. Use a separate development vault. Never insert credentials in this portable JSON.
